title: Enhancing Diabetic Retinopathy Detection with CNN-Based Models: A Comparative Study of UNET and Stacked UNET Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2411.01251v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy DR is a severe complication of diabetes. Damaged or abnormal blood vessels can cause loss of vision. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has generated an interest in a computer-aided fully automatic diagnosis of DR. In the realm of Deep learning frameworks, particularly convolutional neural networks CNNs, have shown great interest and promise in detecting DR by analyzing retinal images. However, several challenges have been faced in the application of deep learning in this domain. High-quality, annotated datasets are scarce, and the variations in image quality and class imbalances pose significant hurdles in developing a dependable model. In this paper, we demonstrate the proficiency of two Convolutional Neural Networks CNNs based models, UNET and Stacked UNET utilizing the APTOS Asia Pacific Tele-Ophthalmology Society Dataset. This system achieves an accuracy of 92.81%

translated_title: 基于CNN模型的糖尿病视网膜病变检测增强：UNET与堆叠UNET架构的比较研究
translated_abstract: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）是糖尿病的一种严重并发症，受损或异常的血管可能导致视力丧失。对大量糖尿病患者进行大规模筛查的需求激发了人们对计算机辅助全自动DR诊断的兴趣。在深度学习框架领域，尤其是卷积神经网络（CNN），在通过分析视网膜图像检测DR方面表现出了巨大的潜力和前景。然而，深度学习在该领域的应用面临着诸多挑战：高质量的标注数据集稀缺，图像质量的差异和类别不平衡问题对开发可靠模型构成了重大障碍。在本文中，我们利用APTOS（亚太远程眼科学会）数据集展示了两种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的模型——UNET和堆叠UNET——的卓越性能，该系统达到了92.81%的准确率。
tldr: 本研究基于APTOS数据集对UNET与堆叠UNET两种CNN架构在糖尿病视网膜病变自动检测中的性能进行了比较研究，实现了92.81%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This study comparatively evaluates UNET and Stacked UNET CNN architectures for automatic diabetic retinopathy detection on the APTOS dataset, achieving an accuracy of 92.81%.
